working_definition: Fat cells of the adult fat body in the AFCA head analysis (adult flies, 5-70 days); the authors' head-specific fat body type ('adult fat body_head', the FCA 'adult fat body' in the head). In the head, the fat body is the pericerebral fat mass.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any fat cell (FBbt:00046052) that is part of some adult pericerebral fat mass (FBbt:00048409).

justification: The authors distinguish a head fat body type ('_head'); head fat is exactly the pericerebral fat mass, so the tissue-specific cell term is exact (curator rule: narrow by dissected tissue only where the tissue implies the term exactly).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Fat cell of the adult fat body. These cells are derived from cells of the larval body wall and adepithelial cells associated with imaginal discs (Hoshizaki et al., 1995; Musselman and Kuhnlein, 2018). Fully-differentiated adult fat cells are found from around 3-4 days after eclosion (Aguila et al., 2007). Unlike the larval fat cells, they are diploid (Musselman and Kuhnlein, 2018).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Correct but less specific: in the head the fat cells are pericerebral (FCA type-level mapping of 'adult fat body').

recommendation: Use adult pericerebral fat cell (FBbt:00058267). Revisit when FBbt issue #2218 (review adult fat terms) is resolved and released.
